card.name: Inside antipyretic and similar rare words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a rare word split into parts, most often "ret" inside "antipyretics" in premedication lists. Also fires on the end of a brand name like AKHZYRO and on "res" in "gyres".

modes.label: Antipyretic spelling
modes.description: The "ret" piece in "antipyretic(s)" listed with antihistamines and corticosteroids.
modes.example: consider pretreating with antihistamines, antipy<<ret>>ics, and/or corticosteroids

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The last piece of a newly coined brand name at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: AKHZ<<YRO>> may be administered by the patient or caregiver

modes.description: A piece inside a rare non-drug word such as gyres.
